set.body:
Why: RowGeometry's whitening/projector/EffectOperator (RowGeometry.scala) is a genuinely distinct, correctly-separate design-conditioning geometry (row-conditioning by a design, not a bilinear inertia form). It should be bridgeable to the duality diagram, not merged into D/Q.

Scope: add a constructor that lets a RowWhitening-derived metric serve as a DualityDiagram row metric D, yielding "design-conditioned GenPCA" without conflating the two geometries.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] A constructor builds an MvMetric (or a DualityDiagram D) from a RowWhitening result.
- [ ] A test fits GenPCA with a design-conditioned D and checks it equals whitening-then-PCA.
- [ ] RowGeometry remains a separate type (no merge); JVM+JS green.
set.title: multivar: bridge (not merge) RowGeometry — RowWhitening-derived D for the diagram
